== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Crimson Vault|The Crimson Vault]], also referred to as [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], is a unique territory that functions primarily as a location designed to kill other [[Travelers]]. It serves as a central hub for Gate travel, though its accessibility is highly restricted; a Gate to the Vault can only be opened from within the primary world and cannot be accessed once a [[Traveler]] has entered another [[Territory]]. Access to the Vault is governed by an ancient pact involving [[Queen]] [[Cynara]], which limits entry to [[Leah]] and her two sisters. To enter the Vault proper, a traveler must pass through silver doors decorated with the image of a long-dead, one-eyed king. These doors are flanked by two scarlet torches that provide the only light within the stone cave environment. The Vault contains various gatecrawlers, which are specialized devices or weapons that can be used to manipulate [[Gates]]. These include tools capable of tearing open recently closed portals and various weapons that can be summoned from the territory. The Vault also acts as a transit point with specific directional limitations; for example, traveling through [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] can lead specifically to the capital of [[Damasca]]. The interior is characterized by unsettling sounds, such as wind-like howling and scratching noises, and the silver doors can slam shut behind those who enter.}}
